method: Reused from map-sources/edco-map-2026-control-points.json: Street intersections the official 2026 map draws, read by eye at 4x on the plate (about +-5 px, at the centre of each drawn road). Their coordinates are the OpenStreetMap nodes recorded for the same four intersections on the 2025 map (api.openstreetmap.org/api/0.6/map, fetched 2026-09-30). Least-squares affine with scripts/georef-map.mjs: rms 9.5 m, worst 11.5 m.
